verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy as supported automation libraries. The only related items describe generic programmatic browser control and Browserbase's own SDK and Stagehand framework, which are not the open-source libraries the story asks about. This axis clearly applies to a hosted headless-browser platform, but it is unevidenced here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build scrapers using popular open-source automation libraries like Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy
